acceptance_criteria: AC-1: GET /api/v1/questions/:id/translations returns locale map + locale_coverage
AC-2: PUT performs atomic upsert; 422 for partial options
AC-3: PUT rejects unsupported locale with 422 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_LOCALE
AC-4: DELETE removes both tables; 409 ERR_CANNOT_DELETE_DEFAULT_LOCALE if default
AC-5: locale_coverage consistent with translation rows
AC-6: PUT/DELETE require questions:write; GET requires questions:read
AC-7: audit log entry for every PUT and DELETE
AC-8: PUT returns full updated translation object
